caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden clock case with a decorative carved crest featuring a brown eagle with outstretched wings at the top center. The main body of the clock is divided into two sections. The upper section houses a large circular clock face with a cream background, black Roman numerals, and black hands. The box surrounding the clock face is adorned with light floral patterns. The lower section contains a painted scene showing a brown horse pulling a carriage with two passengers along a sandy path by a body of water, with blue sky above. The passengers are dressed in green, with one holding reins and the other seated. The frame of the entire clock, including the base and sides, is depicted in shades of brown wood, with slightly ornate, fluted columns at the sides and simple claw-like feet at the bottom. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, monochromatic sketch of the same clock design, boxed in a rectangle and showing simpler line details. The drawing is set on a plain, light background, and the name “John B. Moll Sr.” appears along the bottom right edge, along with the number “253.”
title: Mantle Clock
